home.title: Free Timezone Comparison Tool
home.description: Free timezone converter & world clock. Add any city, compare live times side-by-side, find business hour overlaps & plan meetings instantly.
home.loginPrompt: Login to save your timezone presets and business hours
home.lead: Compare the current time in any cities, see how far apart they are, and find the hours when everyone is at work.
home.aboutBody: Timezone Harmony compares live local times using the IANA time zone database, so daylight saving changes are applied automatically. Add several cities to see a 24-hour timeline, highlight the business hours they share, and export a meeting time to your calendar. Pages for popular city pairs show the current time difference, when it changes next, and the best meeting window.

cityPair.planMeetings: Plan meetings across any time zone
cityPair.planMeetingsDesc: Use Timezone Harmony to compare multiple cities interactively, set a specific meeting time, and export events to your calendar.
cityPair.scheduleMeetingDesc: Pick any time slot and export it to your calendar.
